proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of DewasDoneDanuwar muṭ̚ “urine” (f_ohku5yrmsp7hs). Family evidence: CDIAL 10234 mūtra explicitly gives Kalasha mūtra, Bshk. mūλ and Western Pahari mūc. The survey lateral/sibilant outcomes fit the tr-cluster urine family; retroflex muṭ and ordinary mute preserve the same noun, with phonetic details left open. Reviewed comparison: Dotyali mut̚ “urine” (f_hbdj3vaid2wfw). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.

proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of awan cāṛ “four” (f_6z3uklop7bn2i). Family evidence: CDIAL 4655.3 caturaḥ explicitly gives Bshk. čōr, Kalasha čāu, Khowar čhor, Maiya čōur and Palula čūr. These northern o/u forms require subsection 3, correcting the candidate’s subsection-2 link; western cār remains in subsection 2. Reviewed comparison: awan cār “four” (f_6cgi675l3uxee). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed. CDIAL 4655.2 explicitly includes regional cār from catvāri; these a-vowel forms are retained here, unlike the o/u-vowel northern caturaḥ branch. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.
